spec.description:
Everything not healthy right now, by area: sites, workloads, services, names, network paths, Flux resources, hosts, recovery, restore time, backups and databases. Standby and Not applicable are left out. Empty means nothing needs you. A row opens its area's board.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Current firing alerts

spec.expr: label_replace(max by (cluster, alertname, severity) (ALERTS{cluster=~"$cluster",alertstate="firing",severity!="none"}), "k8s_cluster", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)")

spec.description:
Current Prometheus rule state, excluding heartbeats; this is not a historical Alertmanager event list and does not show silence/inhibition state.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Expected sites

spec.expr: count(max by (k8s_cluster) (homelab_expected_site_info{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"}))

spec.description:
Declared inventory survives the disappearance of a source. This is expected scope, not health.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Reporting sites

spec.expr: count(max by (k8s_cluster) (homelab:site_reporting{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"}) == 1) or vector(0)

spec.description:
Distinct selected sites with fresh, successful evidence. Duplicate observations count once. Compare with Expected sites; partial results never certify fleet health.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Site evidence

spec.expr: max by (k8s_cluster) (homelab:site_state{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"})

spec.description:
Measured site evidence, including explicit Unknown when an expected site stops reporting. Independent site probes distinguish unreachable from unobserved.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Evidence age

spec.expr: time() - homelab_observer_last_success_timestamp_seconds{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"}

spec.description:
Age of the last successful Kubernetes inventory observation. A recent Prometheus scrape alone does not prove the collector is seeing its upstream.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Observed state changes

spec.expr: max by (k8s_cluster, app) (changes(homelab:service_state{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"}[1h]))

spec.description:
Sampled transitions in observed service state. This is supplementary evidence and can miss transitions during a monitoring gap.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Latest workload rollout

spec.expr: time() - homelab_workload_transition_timestamp_seconds{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"}

spec.description:
Time since a workload Ready transition reported by Kubernetes. This is not necessarily its deployment or git revision time.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Available local history

spec.expr: homelab:local_history_seconds{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"}

spec.description:
Observed earliest retained sample, not configured retention. New persistent storage accumulates history gradually.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.
